docstring:
It is still possible (and conjectured by Morris and Saxton) that the weaker bound of
$$2^{O(\mathrm{ex}(n;G))}$$
holds for all $G$ containing a cycle.
references: [EFR86] Erdős, P., Frankl, P. and Rödl, V., *The asymptotic number of graphs not containing a fixed subgraph and a problem for hypergraphs having no exponent*. Graphs Combin. (1986), 113-121.
[MoSa16] Morris, R. and Saxton, D., *The number of $C_{2\ell}$-free graphs*. Adv. Math. (2016), 534-580. [arXiv:1309.2927](https://arxiv.org/abs/1309.2927)
[Va99] Various, *Some of Paul's favorite problems*. Booklet produced for the conference "Paul Erdős and his mathematics", Budapest, July 1999 (1999).
type_pretty:
∀ (k : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph (Fin k)),
  ¬H.IsAcyclic →
    ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑(Erdos59.numFree H n) ≤ 2 ^ (C * ↑(SimpleGraph.extremalNumber n H))
